resources.string: After you launch Casualty, this helper briefly opens BBC iPlayer App info and uses Android TV's Force stop confirmation so every macro starts from a clean iPlayer state. It then selects the existing profile and newest episode, skips one exact Skip trailer control if offered, and Force stops iPlayer again before returning Home after playback. Pause stays in the player. It does not clear iPlayer data or settings, use network debugging, record screens, or send data off this device.
